fields.condition: If a motor vehicle is 25 years or more of age which is not used for any commercial or business purposes

fields.condition: If a motor vehicle is of unique or rare design and of limited product that is an object of curiosity and which is not used for any commercial or business purposes

fields.condition: If a motor vehicle, typically manufactured within the past 14 years, which because of its specific make, model year of manufacture, and exceptional physical condition, is considered to be increasing in value rather than depreciating in value

fields.condition: If an enthusiast vehicle has been retrofitted with an electric drivetrain

fields.condition: If a vehicle was originally manufactured prior to 1950 and has been modified to increase performance
fields.outcome: Then it qualifies as a Hot Rod/Street Rod and is eligible for the Core product

fields.condition: If the vehicle is specifically purpose-built for competition type use rather than street use, including competition cars with historic significance or provenance
fields.outcome: Then the vehicle qualifies as Motorsports and it is eligible for the Core product

fields.condition: If the vehicle has been modified after manufacture for drag racing rather than street use, including at minimum, a roll cage, narrowed rear axle, and enlarged rear wheel wells/wheels
